title: DECAT: dual-expert chemistry-aware Transformer for ozone-pollutant reaction kinetics
description: DECAT is a reproducibility and deployment package for predicting second-order reaction rate constants between ozone and environmental pollutants. It contains the locked 1,626-record, 25-class workflow; the two-layer, four-head Post-LN dual-expert Transformer; the Top-3 validation-ranked checkpoint ensemble; the validation-selected nn_plus_res_rf correction head; a self-contained Streamlit prediction platform; and the seed-242 applicability-domain screening workflow with results for 4,295 unique external structures. The package does not retrain the model. The original third-party paper PDFs are intentionally excluded. The source code is distributed under the MIT License. Data, model weights and derived screening outputs are accompanied by the DECAT research-use terms in LICENSE-DATA-MODEL-RESEARCH-USE.txt; third-party materials remain subject to their original terms.
